description: Scénarios de consommation à horizon 2030 et 2035 (Perspectives Gaz 2024) is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données contient le scénario de consommation de gaz aux horizons 2030 et 2035 issues du document Perspectives gaz 2024. Celui-ci a été réalisé conjointement par GRDF, NaTran et Teréga dans le cadre de l’article L141-10 du code de l’énergie. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Consommation. Its keywords are Prospective. The portal shows 2025-01-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
